Reviewed the complete claim, sole ordinary implementation association in sage_ir::tytree, and sole TODO test sage_meta::todo::types_scoped_identities. The requirements are separate source-backed/external/alpha-equivalent generic identity families; field identity as owner plus index; body-local local identity; exclusion of these scoped identities from global Symbol variants; and retention in semantic values.

Current source inspection supports the local/field representation examples: LocalId is a body-local u32 newtype, ResolvedField contains FieldOwner (struct or variant) and index, PathResolution separates Local from Def(Symbol), TyExprData::Field retains ResolvedField, and TyPatKind::Bind retains LocalId. These facts do not establish all generic families, global Symbol exclusion, or cross-owner behavior. The explicit TODO test defers distinguishing generic, field-owner/index, and body-local identities across unrelated owners. Its empty body has no assertions and provides no behavioral coverage for any requirement. I accept the existing deferral, including generic source/external/alpha identity separation and semantic retention verification; I do not claim those deferred aspects implemented or tested. Completing it requires constructing the relevant generic identity families and semantic values, using distinct owners with overlapping field/local indices, and adding assertions for identity separation/retention (locals interpreted within their own bodies). The currently visible local/field representation suffices to begin these cases; no external blocker is asserted.

Independently verified exact byte equality of current tytree/mod.rs and representation_spec.rs with the historical implementation_sources/test_sources snapshots. This corroborates unchanged evidence, not approval by itself; the current complete claim, metadata, source and TODO rationale were reassessed. Additional review-policy context was captured using review read. No helper behavior or additional implementation files were relied on. No source edits or tests/builds were executed for this review. Executed review start/read and the baseline comparison; coordinator-reported 321 passing tests and root build are separate execution evidence. No edits requested: the missing coverage remains explicitly deferred rather than promoted to completed behavior.
